body:
Big announcement: we’re launching a 254 County Mobilization Plan.
#
The secret to winning in a state as big and diverse as Texas is to not to write anyone off. No county is too small, too Republican, or too _anything_ for us to compete for their votes. We need to go _everywhere_ and talk to _everyone_.
**In that spirit, we’re excited to announce our 254 County Mobilization Plan.**
To reach every single voter, we need a budget for organizing and advertising in each corner of Texas. And four days from now, we have a state-mandated fundraising deadline. We’ll publicly report how much we’ve raised. We want to be able to say we’ve reached our fundraising goals to launch a full-fledged campaign in each of Texas’ 254 counties. That’s where you come in!
**We’ve assigned you to sponsor Anderson County in Texas.** More than 28,856 voters are registered there, and we’ve set a goal of raising $14,428 to launch our 254 County Mobilization plan. **Can Beto count on your help to reach Anderson County voters?** **⇢**[**Make a $25 donation to reach 50 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211227-168846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=4&akid=168846%2E444211%2EcRfnv2)**⇢**[**Make a $50 donation to reach 100 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211227-168846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=5&akid=168846%2E444211%2EcRfnv2)**⇢**[**Make a $100 donation to reach 200 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211227-168846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=6&akid=168846%2E444211%2EcRfnv2)**⇢**[**Make a $250 donation to reach 500 voters in Anderson County.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211227-168846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=7&akid=168846%2E444211%2EcRfnv2) **[Sponsor Anderson County»](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211227-168846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=8&akid=168846%2E444211%2EcRfnv2)**
---
It’s true that most Texans live in big cities and counties. But you cannot expect to win in a state like Texas if you write off the rural counties, which are so vital to the future of this state.
Because these places have voted reliably Republican over the last two decades, you’ve seen many state and national Democrats write them off. And because those Democrats stopped showing up, Republicans didn’t have to either. There was no competition for votes.
**Our 254 County Mobilization plan gives us a BIG edge.** You would be surprised at how many people will vote with us if given a chance to hear from our campaign. In counties where most people vote Republican, competing for votes will help us close the margins. And in counties that often vote Democrat, showing up and organizing will help us increase our margins.
**But the plan only works if we can raise enough money to organize, advertise and show up in all 254 counties.**[**Can you help us hit our fundraising goal for Anderson County before the 12/31 Texas Ethics Commission deadline?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211227-168846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=9&akid=168846%2E444211%2EcRfnv2)
Thank you, for considering a donation to reach the 28,856 registered voters of Anderson County. That’s what a true grassroots campaign looks like. Talking to everyone, writing no one off. Competing for every vote.
\- Team Beto

# Your tax credit - use it or lose it!

subject: The Enemy Within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock you or scare you --_I say it because it 's true._ And I say it with confidence because when I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. **My name is David Horowitz, and 50 years ago I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end.** I was side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited Ramparts - the largest magazine of the radical Left. I marched, I wrote manifestos, and I attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam, and my eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan and never looked back. I created the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left, and dedicated my life to exposing them. I did it because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing, I knew what was at stake, and I knew that if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. **[Today, I'm asking you to join me in this fight, and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $45 or more to my Freedom Center.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59117262:JkgTFyENz:m:1:3298722022:3556214CE43988B780770E3E4ADFE6B7:r)** _What we 're seeing today didn't happen overnight. It's no coincidence. It's no stroke of luck._ **It 's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making.** For decades now, the Freedom Center has been in the trenches, exposing this sinister movement and warning of what was to come. America's domestic enemies have smeared us every step of the way, and worked around the clock to cut off both political and financial support to silence us for good. We've been targeted by MasterCard, DiscoverCard, the Southern Poverty Law Center, and so many more because we're willing to say and do what no one else would to expose the enemy within. That's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain what is happening in this battle now - how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party... ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of the country... ...how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state, and to cancel, de-platform, and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59117262:JkgTFyENz:m:1:3298722022:3556214CE43988B780770E3E4ADFE6B7:r) **" A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza** **" The Enemy Within is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin** **" David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham** I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because I knew that if America stood a chance, Americans had to understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because we've reached the point in our history that will decide our future -- and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[So if you donate $45 or more to the Freedom Center today](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59117262:JkgTFyENz:m:1:3298722022:3556214CE43988B780770E3E4ADFE6B7:r)** and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot, I will send you a complimentary copy _The Enemy Within._ The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make it better -- they want to destroy it and make way for their Marxist dystopia. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat, or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to show our fellow Americans who they really are and what they really want while we still can. Sincerely, David Horowitz P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking, and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $45 or more to the Freedom Center today](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59117262:JkgTFyENz:m:1:3298722022:3556214CE43988B780770E3E4ADFE6B7:r)** , and as a thank you for your generous support, I'll reserve a complimentary copy of my latest book _The Enemy Within_ for you, explaining this in depth. [**Get Your Exclusive Copy of _The Enemy Within_**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59117262:JkgTFyENz:m:1:3298722022:3556214CE43988B780770E3E4ADFE6B7:r) | |

body:
Herschel Walker for Senate

Peter,

Today in America, politicians pit American against American.

Rich vs. Poor. Black vs. White. Urban vs. Rural.

I don't believe in that garbage. It's a lie.

I'm Herschel Walker, and I want you to be among the first to know
that I'm running to be the next United States Senator from
Georgia.

I'm a conservative who believes in smaller government, a strong
military, personal responsibility, and making sure ALL people
have the opportunity to pursue their dreams.

I will win this incredibly important race, but I need your help.
I'm asking you to chip in whatever you can, whether it's $100,
$50, or even just $10 to ensure I'm in the strongest starting
position possible.

Join My Offensive Team Chip In Today →

At my core, I'm a runner. But I wasn't always fast.

I grew up in the small town of Wrightsville, Georgia, where I
learned discipline, faith in God, and the value of hard work.
It's also where I trained non-stop and got real fast.

I'm from a working-class family. I was one of seven children, so
you'd be correct to say my parents had their hands full. My
childhood was a happy one - even more so once I overcame a
stutter and disciplined myself to get in strong physical shape.

Growing up in Georgia, I learned about sacrificing the things you
want in the moment for the future you know you can have ... if
you work hard enough.

Growing up in Georgia, I also learned it doesn't matter where you
come from, what your family has, or what color your skin is - if
you want something bad enough and you're willing to work hard for
it, you can achieve it.

You may know of me from my days playing college football at the
University of Georgia, where I was awarded the Heisman Trophy in
1982.

I was blessed to be successful in college football, enough so
that my college career paved the way for me to play football
professionally for many years in the USFL and NFL.

My career took me all over the country. Despite living in New
Jersey when I played for the Generals, Dallas when I played for
the Cowboys, Minneapolis when I played for the Vikings, or
Philadelphia and New York when I played for the Eagles and the
Giants, respectively, my heart was always in Georgia.

And at this moment in time, I'm deeply concerned about the future
of Georgia and our country.

Unfortunately, a liberal Democrat was elected to the U.S. Senate
from Georgia in a runoff election earlier this year, and he's now
serving out the last two years of a beloved former Republican
senator's term.

The future of Georgia - and our country - is too important for me
to stand on the sideline as radical liberals take our country
down the wrong path.

That's why I'm running for the United States Senate.

Join My Offensive Team Chip In Today →

I'm just a guy from a small town in Georgia who's been blessed by
God to live the American Dream.

I'm ready to fight to keep that dream alive - for you too.

Very Respectfully,

Herschel Walker

P.S. The liberals in Washington are going to unleash everything
they've got to defeat me, so I need you on my team. Please help
my campaign get off to a critically important start by donating
$10, $20, or even $50 today. Thank you.

subject: What's on my mind today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
The American experience can withstand anything so long as we defend it
| | |
---
It's been a year, friend.
A year since the sitting president of the United States incited an insurrection on our Capitol – the temple of American democracy – a bone-chilling, violent riot that laid siege to overturn a free and fair election; an insurrection in which lives were lost, including five fellow law enforcement officers, and dozens were injured; an attempted coup that continues to cast a dark shadow over our nation.
For as long as I live, friend, I will never forget how the events of Jan. 6 unfolded before my eyes. I was there that day following the orders from the Capitol police officers to 'get down.' We could hear the insurrectionists marching, shouting, banging through the halls. I offered some of my colleagues Scripture as comfort. **I reminded them that "we are going to win and democracy is going to stand."**
Nearly a year later, as the GOP pushes back against investigating the insurrection, the stakes of our democracy are clear as day, friend. **Either we hand our congressional majorities to a party whose elected officials enable Donald Trump and the lies that led to the insurrection – or we fight with everything we have for our democracy, a beacon of light from which opportunity, prosperity and hope are made available for all. **

Together, we can rebuke and defeat the violent extremism of Trump's Republican Party. We can continue with the bold progress Democrats are making for the American people. And we can ensure our country stands for the rule of law and democracy – but not if we don't fight for it.
**That's what I'm in this Senate race for, friend. The American experience can withstand anything so long as we defend it.**
Let me say it again, what I said to my colleagues on that awful day when the strength of our nation was tested: We are going to win, and democracy is going to stand.

Val Demings

Hello,
We are a group of ten current Iowa state representatives, and we are writing to you today because our state and our country need your help.
As Democratic elected officials in Iowa with decades of service, we’ve fought for years on important issues like providing better access to health care, combating climate change, improving education, and strengthening our democracy. **It’s precisely for that reason that we’ve endorsed Admiral Mike Franken to be Iowa’s next U.S. senator.**
Mike Franken represents the best of Iowa. As a three-star admiral who served nearly 40 years in the Navy, he’s lived a life dedicated to service. And as a native son of rural northwest Iowa, he has a personal understanding of the many different challenges Iowans face.
Our current senator, Republican Chuck Grassley, has forgotten the reason he was sent to Washington 46 years ago. Rather than representing the interests of everyday Iowans, he seems now only to care about the corporations and special interests writing him campaign checks.
Mike Franken is absolutely the best person to take on Chuck Grassley because he can run a winning campaign across all 99 counties in Iowa. **But if he’s going to win, he’s counting on grassroots support from donors like you.**
In just a few days, Mike is facing his first end-of-quarter FEC deadline, and after December 31st, federal law requires his campaign to publicly release his fundraising numbers. Everyone will be closely scrutinizing his report – from reporters to Mitch McConnell’s Super PACs – looking for signs of weakness.

name: Ben Downing
subject: Today, I am formally ending my bid to become the next Governor of Massachusetts.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Downing Committee
body:
Team,

For everything there is a season. For this campaign, that season has come to a close. Today, I am formally ending my bid to become the next Governor of Massachusetts.

I do so with a heavy heart, but also with hope, and gratitude beyond measure. Over the last 10 months, friends and neighbors, old and new, have opened their homes and hearts to my campaign. Together, we built a coalition that lifted up the voices of those too often ignored. We came up with real solutions to meet the challenges facing Massachusetts families and reshape our shared future.

In a year that took a lot out of all of us, we grew stronger at the broken places. I have seen the best of Massachusetts, alongside the deep need for more urgent, empathetic leadership. I have learned and grown. For all of that, I cannot say thank you enough. Unfortunately, we simply do not have the financial resources to continue. While it’s painful to admit, that reality has brought this chapter to a close.

Just as my work and my responsibility as a citizen did not end when I term limited myself in the Senate, the work of this campaign does not end today. Though my name will not be on the ballot next year, I will keep working for the principles that defined this campaign.

Massachusetts is prosperous, but we must ask “for whom?” and reckon with the reality that the answer is for far too few. Massachusetts is innovative, but we must ask “to what end?” and reckon with the fact that we are falling far short on the defining issues of this generation — most notably the climate crisis.

We have everything we need to solve the big problems facing us. It is not a single political party that stands in the way, but a culture of complacency that too often prioritizes the comfort of those in power over addressing the challenges of those in need. Until that dynamic changes, our work is not done and you’ll find me standing shoulder to shoulder with anyone striving to build a Massachusetts that works for everyone, everywhere.

To everyone who made this possible — thank you. To the team who encouraged, inspired, and challenged me every single day, this was an incredible adventure. Thanks to you. To the friends, family and supporters who fueled us over the last year, you were a constant source of strength in a year marked by uncertainty and change. And to Micaelah, thank you for being you and loving me, on the good days and the bad. I wouldn’t be able to do anything without you.

For now, I am off to chase Mac and Eamon. When they tucker themselves out, know I will be right there with you as we chase the Massachusetts we all want to live in, the Massachusetts we know is possible.

| Peter,
My husband, Mike, is running for Senate because he believes in the American Dream.
I've been married to Mike for many years and raised five children together. In that time, I've seen him take on many roles over the years. He's a great husband, a world-class father, an influential youth sports coach and advocate, and a self-made businessman.
Many don't realize this, but Mike didn't start his own business until he was 37. His career started on the factory floor, pouring concrete, and working LONG hours to provide for his family.
Mike is a good man and the kind of principled and moral individual who will serve you faithfully in public office.
I'm so proud of my husband for doing what he believes is best for Ohio and for our country. He has my full support and I hope you will have yours as well, Peter.
Will you please donate today and support his campaign? You can donate by going to https://secure.winred.com/gibbons-for-ohio/email
I know Mike is the best man to make our country great again.
Thank you,
Diane Gibbons

# #1 Item to Hoard In 2021
According to leading industry sources, grocery stores across the United States are worried about food shortages. Experts say more grocery hoarding may come as disruptions push America's food supply "near its breaking point". **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to be hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means your family can become malnourished...

Well, I decided not to worry anymore. Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by most stores. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of the best-selling [**4Patriots Survival Food Kits**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c11518%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D%2fHKgshW%2bUGMIOxR08Ditg&sysid=1). Currently 4Patriots survival food kits are flying off the shelves because:

This is delicious, nutritious, good-for-25-years super survival food that protects you from going hungry in a crisis. They are made right in the U.S.A. and you won't believe how inexpensive these kits are - just a **fraction of what some other brands charge**.

This food has a **shelf life of up to 25 years** , so you have complete peace of mind for the long term. And they're using the most compact kits so you can store them anywhere in your house without any extra hassle. They're sturdy, water-resistant and stack easily. And extremely covert too.
* You can make these meals in less than 20 minutes. Just add boiling water, simmer, and serve. I tried 'em and I think they **taste as good or better than any other survival food I've ever had**. And you get a whole slew of choices for breakfast, lunch and dinner so you don't get stuck eating the same thing day-in and day-out.

body:
I’m writing to you today to tell you a hard truth about what it will take to flip this Senate seat and then, I’m going to ask you to make a small donation to my campaign ahead of our final FEC fundraising deadline of the year. Before I do, I want to share why I decided to run against Ron Johnson in the first place.

The truth is, I never planned to run for public office. But when Scott Walker tried to consolidate power and get rid of Wisconsin’s fiscal watchdog, I knew I had to do something about it. So, I launched a grassroots effort to take him on and save the State Treasurer’s office.

**Our scrappy campaign won with 62% of the vote statewide. It was the kind of landslide victory that just doesn't happen in Wisconsin.**

Then, I decided to run for the office that I worked so hard to save — flipping nine Trump counties and winning more of the vote share than the Governor, Lt. Governor, and Attorney General in a down-ballot race.

That should tell you a lot about me. I didn’t run for public office for fame, money, or power. I first ran because politicians like Scott Walker slammed the door on working families. I believed Wisconsinites deserved to have someone fighting for their best interests, not bending to the will of wealthy donors and corporate interests.

From Ashland to Marinette to Janesville and everywhere in-between, I’ve proven that I can compete and win all over our beautiful state. That’s why I’m mounting my third grassroots campaign — this time, for the United States Senate.

The fact is, Ron Johnson hasn’t just lost touch with Wisconsin workers and families, he’s lost touch with reality. We need someone who will fight for the kitchen-table issues that matter most — like guaranteed paid leave, lower prescription drug costs, affordable child care, good-paying union jobs, the right to vote, and an economy that works for everyone. That’s why I’m in this fight.

With our 50/50 Democratic Senate majority hanging in the balance by just one seat, all eyes will be on us. _CNN_ has already called Ron Johnson the most vulnerable incumbent GOP Senator up in 2022, and _The Cook Political Report_ moved Wisconsin from Lean R to Toss-Up. Our race is heating up.

I’m the only Democrat beating Ron Johnson in the latest poll of our race, but we have a long way to go to get to the finish line. If we want to defeat him at the ballot box, I’ll need your help to build another winning campaign because flipping this seat will require lots of grassroots support from folks like you. So, I’m humbly asking:

[**Would you consider adding a small donation to my campaign ahead of our final FEC deadline of the year? I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, which means anything you can contribute will make a meaningful difference in our race to flip Wisconsin blue and defeat Ron Johnson. name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: We’re just getting started
body:
We're just getting started

Dear
Peter,
It was my
honor and privilege to serve the American people as the 17th
Secretary of Housing and Urban Development. However, when the
prior Administration ended earlier this year, I knew there was
too much work left to do to sit on the sidelines.
The work
is evident when you look at what has happened over the past year:

A
Progressive movement is working to rewrite our nation's history
to fit their narrative

The
nation has never been more divided with both sides of the aisle
unable to compromise on even the most basic ideas

And a
"social infrastructure" bill is one step closer to turning our
nation into a welfare state

Peter,
that's why I started the American Cornerstone Institute earlier
this year.
I know
first-hand how America can be the land of opportunity. I
experienced how a good education can allow children to become
anything they set their mind to.
I also
know that the key to success is hard work, not handouts. It is
teaching children that they have to earn their place in the
world; it won't simply be given to them.
This was
the basis for our work at ACI this year. We created a school
curriculum that teaches children to be proud of America's
Founding Fathers. We fought for the unborn by adding Amicus
Briefs to the Supreme Court cases that have the potential to
overturn Roe v. Wade. We contributed to the National debate daily
through media appearances and news articles. And, we have held 15
virtual Cornerstone Conversations with issue experts so everyone,
anywhere can hear more than a news soundbite on the topics
shaping our nation today.
We've
accomplished so much in the first year, thanks in large part to
supporters like you, but we are just getting started.
2022 is
certain to bring more challenges and more opportunities. To meet
those head on, we rely on the generous donations of people like
you.
I don't
usually like asking for money, but this is too important. The
future of our country is at stake.
Would you
be willing to make a tax-deductible contribution before December
31? Your support will go directly to our efforts to advance the
principles that made America great.
You can
make a donation at this secure link:
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/year-end
Thank you
for what you have already done to keep America the greatest
country on earth.

Sincerely,
Dr. Ben
Carson

--
Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder
and Chairman
American
Cornerstone Institute

clean_body: We're just getting started Dear Peter, It was my honor and privilege to serve the American people as the 17th Secretary of Housing and Urban Development. However, when the prior Administration ended earlier this year, I knew there was too much work left to do to sit on the sidelines. The work is evident when you look at what has happened over the past year: A Progressive movement is working to rewrite our nation's history to fit their narrative The nation has never been more divided with both sides of the aisle unable to compromise on even the most basic ideas And a "social infrastructure" bill is one step closer to turning our nation into a welfare state Peter, that's why I started the American Cornerstone Institute earlier this year. I know first-hand how America can be the land of opportunity. I experienced how a good education can allow children to become anything they set their mind to. I also know that the key to success is hard work, not handouts. It is teaching children that they have to earn their place in the world; it won't simply be given to them. This was the basis for our work at ACI this year. We created a school curriculum that teaches children to be proud of America's Founding Fathers. We fought for the unborn by adding Amicus Briefs to the Supreme Court cases that have the potential to overturn Roe v. Wade. We contributed to the National debate daily through media appearances and news articles. And, we have held 15 virtual Cornerstone Conversations with issue experts so everyone, anywhere can hear more than a news soundbite on the topics shaping our nation today. We've accomplished so much in the first year, thanks in large part to supporters like you, but we are just getting started. 2022 is certain to bring more challenges and more opportunities. To meet those head on, we rely on the generous donations of people like you. I don't usually like asking for money, but this is too important. The future of our country is at stake. Would you be willing to make a tax-deductible contribution before December 31? Your support will go directly to our efforts to advance the principles that made America great. body:
We need to grow our majority with Democrats who will stand with us when it counts.
#
Peter,
**Just a few days from now, we’re facing our most important FEC fundraising deadline of the year -- and we can’t afford to show any signs of weakness.** I’m emailing to ask that you make a contribution and become a 2022 Founding Donor, but first, let me take a moment to explain why your support has never been so important.
I am sure you are frustrated that Build Back Better has not yet passed – I am too. But that just means the fight continues, and you know can count on me to keep working for affordable child care, action on the climate crisis, paid leave for workers and so much more that we need to do to come back from this pandemic stronger and fairer.
**[It’s not enough to defeat Mitch McConnell and keep the Senate blue -- we need to grow our majority with Democrats who will stand with us when it counts. Will you pitch in $5 right now to become a 2022 Founding Donor and join me in this fight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40104943/322884055/209446279?refcode=pm_em_211228_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzM0ZDk3NC0wMTY4LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDUwZjJlNjVlOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=St3rbn7Q17WgR_z1QIvvdgoGv0NhadeOzaVngbBGHTA=)**
Every day in the other Washington, I’ve been focused on passing legislation that centers working families in Washington state -- like the American Rescue Plan and the Democrats’ historic bipartisan infrastructure bill.
But here’s the catch: Mitch McConnell and the GOP have made it clear they’ll stop at nothing to unravel the progress we’ve made. They’ve blocked voting rights reform, voted no to economic recovery packages, and Roe v. Wade is under attack in GOP legislatures around the country and in our courts.
We’re all feeling the frustration of only having a razor-thin majority. But if Republicans are willing to block all this crucial action, I don’t even want to imagine what they will do if they retake the Senate next year.
_**That’s why it’s so it’s critical we defend -- and expand -- the Senate majority in 2022.**_
**[Peter, I’m reaching out to supporters like you to ask you to pitch in $5 or anything you can towards our $25,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal and become a 2022 Founding Donor today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40104944/322884056/209446279?refcode=pm_em_211228_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzM0ZDk3NC0wMTY4LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDUwZjJlNjVlOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=St3rbn7Q17WgR_z1QIvvdgoGv0NhadeOzaVngbBGHTA=)**
Our FEC fundraising numbers go public after the quarter ends and Democrats can’t show any signs that we’re losing momentum going into 2022.

As we head into the final days of 2021, I’m reaching out to wish you and your family the very best and to report back on the results of our recent end-of-year survey. By a strong margin, protecting voting rights was the issue of most concern to those who completed the survey — and I share your alarm. The recent laws being passed by Republican state legislatures around the country make access to the ballot box more difficult, particularly for people of color and younger voters. And they give political operatives in some states the power to overturn election results! These laws threaten the legitimacy of our electoral process. And as we approach a midterm election that could shape our country for generations, the implications are potentially enormous. We simply cannot afford to fail to act. As I have been, I will continue to work to push the Senate to end or amend the filibuster in order to protect voting rights when the Senate returns on January 3rd. With Republicans — and Trump — eyeing 2022 as their springboard for the 2024 presidential election, everything is on the line in these upcoming midterm elections. Peter,

You and I have fought together for freedom for years now. T**he increasingly radical Democrats will stop at nothing to force their socialist agenda on America,** which is why they are directing all their resources towards breaking the 50-50 Senate tie and increasing their power in Washington.

_Their top target?_ Missouri's soon-to-be vacated U.S. Senate seat currently held by a Republican. America, and Missouri, literally cannot afford for the Democrats to come in and take this seat. **We must band together and support a rock-solid conservative who is prepared for the job - Missouri 's own, Congressman Billy Long.**

[**I 've already joined Billy on the campaign trail, and plan to continue, but need grassroots conservatives like you to join us.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121688:JvV_8CENy:m:1:3298722022:6F2B2DEA16C7CFA7AABED010BE81F147:r)

[** SUPPORT BILLY LONG NOW ➞ **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121688:JvV_8CENy:m:1:3298722022:6F2B2DEA16C7CFA7AABED010BE81F147:r)
From day one in Washington, **Billy fought to implement the America First Agenda by standing up to Communist China and encouraging American companies to expand right here in the United States.** He has cut taxes and regulations, and helped small businesses thrive. Billy is a friend to the unborn, our military veterans and law enforcement. **His loyalty to the American people has never wavered.**

_I 'm writing to tell you this:_ **If we put Billy Long in the U.S. Senate, we won 't have to worry about him giving into the swamp.** His vote will be for you. What you see is what you get. He's been in Washington for 10 years, **but he 's never been of Washington.**

He's not just talking the talk, like the power-hungry Democrats do. Billy passed legislation to release Missourian workers from unnecessary government regulations, improving their economic situation and quality of life.

_Sounds like the opposite of what the radical-Democrats are doing in Washington, right?_ **Because unlike Joe Biden, Kamala Harris or Chuck Schumer, Billy understands that Americans should ALWAYS come first.** That's the type of Republican we need fighting for us, Peter.

This race is going to be competitive and it will certainly be one of the most expensive battles we see this cycle. [**The only way we 're going to be able to keep Missouri in Republican hands is if conservatives like you join our team right now.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121688:JvV_8CENy:m:1:3298722022:6F2B2DEA16C7CFA7AABED010BE81F147:r)

[** SUPPORT BILLY LONG NOW ➞ **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121688:JvV_8CENy:m:1:3298722022:6F2B2DEA16C7CFA7AABED010BE81F147:r)
Even President Trump is confident that we can and will take back the Senate, but that plan becomes increasingly difficult if the Democrats swoop in and buy and lie their way into one of our red-state seats. **Let me tell you, Democrats already have their eyes and pocketbooks set on Missouri.**

They aren't wasting any time using big corporations and dark-money donors to pad their campaign accounts. [**Peter, that 's why I am counting on you to step up immediately, asking that you give generously to ensure my friend Billy Long has the resources he needs to keep Missouri RED for the Republican Party.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121688:JvV_8CENy:m:1:3298722022:6F2B2DEA16C7CFA7AABED010BE81F147:r)

Thank you,

Kellyanne Conway
Former Counselor to President Donald J. Trump

Peter,

We wanted to reach out about ways we can all help give back to our communities during this season of giving.

2021 has continued to be a challenging year, and during this holiday season, it's important to remember many of our neighbors are struggling. Folks from all walks of life and all backgrounds are experiencing food insecurity, homelessness, climate injustice, and more. We all can do our part to help.

Friend,

With our election just 63 days away, I'm going to ask you to chip in $ to our final FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. But first, I want to talk about an issue that inspired me to run for Congress: **expanding Medicare for seniors who are 65 years and older, and implementing single-payer healthcare.**

You might not know this, but oftentimes, seniors are unable to pay for essential dental work. That's because even with dental insurance, the cost of major dental work like root canals, crowns, and implants are in the thousands of dollars. Many seniors who worked their entire lives are suffering because they can’t afford to get the care on their fixed incomes. It doesn’t have to be this way. We are overpaying for health care and dental care. We must lower the cost of health care.

Build Back Better was supposed to expand Medicare to include coverage for dental, vision, and hearing -- essential care to improve quality of life for seniors. Yet dental and vision coverage was removed from the bill in the House, even before it got to the Senate! That’s unacceptable and must change.

**We need leaders in Congress to build consensus and deliver solutions for the American people. We need representatives to actively advocate for seniors in Congress -- that’s exactly what I will do if elected.**

**[This isn't the time to let up on health care. You might not know this, but oftentimes, seniors are unable to pay for essential dental work. That's because even with dental insurance, the cost of major dental work like root canals, crowns, and implants are in the thousands of dollars. Many seniors who worked their entire lives are suffering because they can’t afford to get the care on their fixed incomes. It doesn’t have to be this way. We are overpaying for health care and dental care. We must lower the cost of health care. Build Back Better was supposed to expand Medicare to include coverage for dental, vision, and hearing -- essential care to improve quality of life for seniors. Hello Peter,

As the end of the year approaches, I am writing to ask for your support of my son Seth in his race to be the next Governor of Rhode Island.

Ever since Seth was a little boy growing up in Bristol, he's had a passion for helping people that would later motivate him to pursue public service. One story that captures Seth took place when he was in the fourth grade. He noticed that the auditorium balcony at his elementary school was in disrepair, so not all the students were able to go to all the programs at the school. He thought that was unfair to the students who were left out, so he went directly to the principal and made the case about why it needed to be repaired. He brought his list of fundraising ideas and important people to approach to get the job done.

Like that little boy of long ago, when Seth sees something that's broken, he does what it takes to fix it. He has done that as Treasurer with his once-in-a-generation school construction initiative, and he will continue working to rebuild a stronger Rhode Island for everyone when he is elected Governor.

Seth strongly believes that every person should have the chance to achieve the American Dream, and he is ready to put in the work to fight for a better future for all Rhode Islanders. He doesn’t want anybody to be left out or left behind. He knows that in order to build a 21st-century economy where everyone can succeed, Rhode Island needs to invest in clean energy jobs and job training, and to address the structural barriers that have held back communities of color. He knows that providing an excellent education to people of all ages and backgrounds is fundamental to this.

What sets Seth apart from other candidates is that he not only has the compassion to be a great Governor, but he also has the experience and an impressive record of accomplishment in office. He has been an outstanding Treasurer and he will be an outstanding Governor. I hope you will join me in supporting him today.

[**Will you support Seth before his end-of-year deadline by making a contribution to his campaign for Governor today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40110683/322905339/1154052794?refcode=em21_211228_EOY1_fnd_gq_act___SM_ettx&utm_campaign=em21_211228_EOY1_fnd_gq_act___SM_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYjYxOGY2ZS0xMjY4LWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDUwZjJlNjVlOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e4pgIF8EWRe-pOk6YHD7hL3oE68k2grMYBzE6ih4h8I=)

I'm deeply grateful for anything you can give.

Warmly,

Suzanne Magaziner

name: Tim Ryan
subject: my first run for office
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tim Ryan for Ohio
body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=1808%2E3611125%2EJkH4pp ][IMG]

Folks—

I have a rare 15 minutes open in my schedule today, so I wanted to take
the time to tell you about my very first run for office.

Growing up in Niles, Ohio I saw manufacturing plants shut down and jobs
shipped overseas. My family, my neighbors—all these hardworking folks
around me—were working their tails off, doing everything right, and still
falling behind.

I didn’t see any politicians looking out for families like mine.

If I could do anything, even the smallest thing to help them, I’d do it—so
I ran for state senate to make their lives better. Because that’s what I
thought elected office was (and still is) about: solving problems and
improving people’s lives.

I had very little campaign cash, so to get the biggest bang for my buck, I
decided to go where the largest number of people would show up every day.
My team and I got an Ohio Department of Transportation map and found the
busiest intersections in my district.

Every morning and afternoon rush hour, in the rain, snow, sleet, or hail,
we were there holding campaign signs. People appreciated our daily effort.
Mostly I’d get smiles, and occasionally I got the finger. But if I was
willing to work that hard to get the job, they felt they could trust me to
work just as hard for them once in office.

I’ve worked every day since to prove them right, and to fight tooth and
nail for hardworking Ohioans.

Now I’m running for U.S. Senate because Ohioans deserve two Senators
looking out for them and their families.

There’s a lot of ground to cover when you’re running statewide, and it
will take a lot more than campaign signs to combat the mountains of cash
the GOP is throwing at us. So, I’m reaching out directly to you:

I’m relying on you to help me get my workers-first message out to every
corner of Ohio. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/6355?t=1007&akid=1808%2E3611125%2EJkH4pp ]Can I count on you to chip in any amount you can before
my end-of-year deadline? I promise I’ll never stop working for you.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/6354?t=1009&amount=25&akid=1808%2E3611125%2EJkH4pp ]Chip in >>

Let’s do this!

—Tim

In DC - and in Georgia - KNEW they could never defeat me on an uneven playing field, so they went back to an old playbook and changed the rules - they redrew the lines of my district to add a massive amount of new Democrat voters to the electorate. **They can't beat me, so they gerrymandered me out of Congress, but if you act now, we can implement my plan to defeat them before the end of the year.** **[If you want to help stand in the way of the left's 2022 socialist agenda, then I need every conservative reading this email to donate before the end of the year.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121699:63fWLCENe:m:1:3298722022:A9C2E64F640D5918ABA9A868E41B0B34:r "If you want to help stand in the way of the left’s 2022

They thought they had the market cornered, and they laughed at Trump when he announced he was running, and then laughed until he won. Still, I need you to do all you can to help me fight these socialists and the RINOs who support them. **[_If you supported me before,_ I need you to dig even deeper and do all you can to help me before the end of the year.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121699:63fWLCENe:m:1:3298722022:A9C2E64F640D5918ABA9A868E41B0B34:r "If you supported me before, I need you to dig even deeper and do
all you can to help me before the end of the year.")** **[If you haven't stood with me before, I need you to step up and help me continue the fight for freedom in the Halls of Congress while Nancy and AOC look for the next way to punish me.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121699:63fWLCENe:m:1:3298722022:A9C2E64F640D5918ABA9A868E41B0B34:r "If you haven’t stood with me before, I need you to step up and help me continue the fight for freedom in the Halls of Congress while

body:
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the Un
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zm5ie90ell4klcc1dse6qq8agfo3pgsblo2ek2kg_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm4qj6d9jmpqj7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sb6mjg69cr5egobdd31c1or8sb7mjjrcdhgeurb7dj46pjmashn66pj3djjehrjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup30phhe2pm1ptie9j30s5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zd17a4fs7o0qponr5lqkhb8ti2hfnisg2rqvge38_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4dlnpop9aj1r1d3pip9cl2ld20kfs61246ks4l8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhi9t6iuj2oghrdkhb3gbk44cua0rnl9njige280_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv0iv02hhvke4ng073el5e4f98hklhv8mueoct28_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoassahtgsnfmod70s34gitd551eo7vu2qjtd6c0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. And they brought it to news outlets like Fox News, Newsmax, the Blaze, and numerous talk radio shows. Ultimately, Campus Reform’s exposure of the truth got _results_. In these cases and many others, **Campus Reform’s quick and powerful action forced universities to change their anti-conservative policies, discipline leftist student groups, and suspend or fire radical professors.** I believe an angel gets its wings every time a leftist professor is fired for their outrageous and unapologetic abuses against conservatives. But Campus Reform’s fight to make the left see the light and feel the heat won’t be won overnight. **To fight the forces of the intolerant left, stand up for free speech, and protect conservative students who want to simply share their beliefs without getting a black eye, Campus Reform is counting on your help.** [**Please make a generous investment of $25, $35, $50, or more today to support the Leadership Institute’s Campus Reform, stand up to liberal indoctrination, and ensure conservative students don’t lose their freedoms on college campuses.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znargph06h5242nrphk5bpi25ok3s3t2liuq77m8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) Friend, let’s make ‘em pay. [**Please help Campus Reform right away so they can empower conservative students and strike back at the lunatic liberals.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj533nf08hljmh5s31kjf8jg8akulijk7g1pf8d0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) Thank you. In liberty, Ann Coulter **P.S. Remember, when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book,_Resistance is Futile_.** It’s just one more way I can thank you for joining this crucial cause. Because **if we lose the kids, we lose this country.** [**Please donate right away.](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zt5k25adku6kqag8ocq90haf5q5dfn6d1rg9efso_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs) Thank you.** [ **Yes, I'll join Campus Reform in the fight against leftist tyranny** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgdkqd8na9n6s6nrl3n4b678snb2hnth0i6s3ss0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth68or2cph2bs)

clean_body: It is essential to the Chicago Machine that not one of their members ever loses a primary. | | | Team, There’s a reason that so many of our elected representatives have been in power for decades. Every election, they make sure voters believe that a new, better, Democratic party is impossible. That they are the best we can get. That’s why, in an election cycle where Democrats are in serious danger of losing the House, Nancy Pelosi chose to come to Chicago just to campaign for Rep Danny Davis, even as she skipped visits to any of Illinois' frontline districts. It is essential to the Chicago Machine that not one of their members ever loses a primary, because it could open the gates to an entirely new generation of leadership, and more than anything else, they seek to hold on to power. Democratic party is being held back by representatives who have been in power for far too long. Whether it’s Joe Manchin, Rahm Emanuel, or Danny Davis, the rule is, if you have power, you are entitled to it for the rest of your life. But look where that has gotten us. We don’t just need more Democrats, we need better Democrats. Better Democrats to pass Build Back Better. Better Democrats to protect our voting rights. Better Democrats to finally stand up for Gun Violence Prevention. Thank you, Kina Collins | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

Peter,
It’s time! We are officially at the end of our final financial quarter of the year. As a quick reminder, every three months, we are bound by campaign finance laws to report all our donation data to the Federal Election Commission. This quarter, we’re aiming to raise the same amount that we did last quarter. **That could be a challenge, given that our donations have slowed dramatically during the holidays. **
As you can see, this past week has been difficult for us. **We need to turn our fundraising numbers around, and quickly.** But I have faith in all of our grassroots supporters like yourself. You may open and read our emails, but haven’t donated yet. I understand that many of us have extra expenses during the holidays. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Broken promises cannot deter the path to Build Back Better
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I refuse to stand by and let this transformative agenda go down without a fight.
#
Peter -
Our popular Build Back Better Act is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to make child care more affordable, lower health insurance premiums, cut the cost of prescription drugs, invest in housing, and so much more — _all in one bill_.
**I refuse to stand by and let this long-overdue agenda go down without a fight.**
That's why I took a moment to write an op-ed for the Washington Post that discusses why we _must_ continue doing everything possible to move forward on Build Back Better. As the Omicron variant continues to upend people's ability to work, care for children and elders, access medical care, and so much more, it's clear: **we cannot afford to abandon our vision. Not with so much on the line.**
[**If you're still with me in the fight for delivering on our popular and progressive priorities in the Build Back Better Act, will you chip in $3 toward our December 31 deadline goal of $322,500? We need to start 2022 strong — and I know we will with supporters like you on our side.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20211228?refcode=em20211228-909&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&refcode2=909_420207_tFTrON&akid=909%2E420207%2EtFTrON)
**[Chip in $3 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20211228?refcode=em20211228-909&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=909_420207_tFTrON&akid=909%2E420207%2EtFTrON)**
* * *
**Broken promises cannot deter the path to Build Back Better**
By: Pramila Jayapal
December 26, 2021 Nearly a year ago, President Biden laid out his Build Back Better agenda: a broad vision to meet the individual and collective challenges Americans face, necessarily ambitious to address crises both created and exposed by the pandemic. For most of 2021, Democrats worked to pass legislation that realizes that vision. The president negotiated with Congress, including Sens. Joe Manchin III (D-W.Va.) and Kyrsten Sinema (D-Ariz.) directly. Sen. Manchin committed to the president — who relayed that commitment to House members — that he would support the legislative framework unveiled on Oct. 28. But on Dec. 20, Sen. Manchin went back on his commitment to the president and seemingly killed the bill on national television. In a town where your word is everything, this was a stunning rebuke of his own party's president. Despite that, we must move forward. The president's agenda is even more urgent today. The omicron variant is surging as covid-19 has once again disrupted people's ability to work, care for children and elders, access medical care and make ends meet. We simply cannot abandon our vision. To craft a path forward, it's important to look at how we got here. Last spring, the Congressional Progressive Caucus (CPC) called for one comprehensive bill to deliver the president's agenda. But seeking a show of bipartisanship, the White House, at the urging of conservative Democratic senators, split the legislation into two vehicles: what eventually became the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and the Build Back Better Act. The latter contained 85 percent of the president's domestic agenda. This decision's effect was to push Build Back Better — and the communities it would uniquely benefit — to the back of the line. People of color, women and young people helped deliver the White House and Congress to Democrats, but their needs were consistently delayed in search of bipartisanship. Low-hanging bipartisan provisions were prioritized over the transformational: child care to allow women to return to the workplace, assistance for caregiving jobs primarily held by immigrant women of color, climate action, lower drug prices, a road map to citizenship for immigrants, and tax reforms taking on special interests. Dividing the president's agenda gave corporate America a chance to dedicate itself to killing Build Back Better. When Senate Democrats passed the infrastructure bill without a commitment of support for Build Back Better, the CPC was left to protect the latter — often in the face of remarkable pressure. Yet a majority of our caucus twice held the line, refusing to pass infrastructure until serious negotiations took place on Build Back Better. President Biden worked with the two senators and the House to craft the Oct. 28 framework agreement. The CPC held the line again to translate the framework into legislation, inking an agreement with six remaining holdouts among House Democrats to ensure our chamber passed both bills. A majority of our members relied on the president's word that he had a commitment from Sen. Manchin to support the framework. We believed we had reached our point of maximum leverage — and if we held up infrastructure again, Sen. Manchin would walk away from Build Back Better entirely and possibly even both proposals. The Progressive Caucus will continue to work toward legislation for Build Back Better, focused on keeping it as close to the agreed-upon framework as possible. At the same time, we are calling on the president to use executive action to immediately improve people's lives. Taking executive action will also make clear to those who hinder Build Back Better that the White House and Democrats will deliver for Americans. The CPC will soon release a plan for these actions, including lowering costs, protecting the health of every family, and showing the world that the United States is serious about our leadership on climate action. We can't be naive about the difficulty of once again negotiating with someone who has not kept his commitments. But legislation remains the best path for delivering enduring relief. Nor can we underestimate the urgency to act, especially as covid is surging and so many constituencies — seniors, people of color, working and young people — are disillusioned. Democrats must prove that their voices and their votes matter, and that we can produce tangible economic assistance. The Progressive Caucus has always believed in leaving no one behind. We call on our governing partners to join us in advancing that philosophy, guided by racial, gender and economic justice — not corporations' bottom lines. This moment for the Biden administration and Congress can either lead to our greatest failure or our greatest success. If we use every tool at our disposal to redouble our efforts to deliver for our communities, with the most urgent needs of the American people as our guide, success is possible.

Peter - Our popular Build Back Better Act is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to make child care more affordable, lower health insurance premiums, cut the cost of prescription drugs, invest in housing, and so much more — all in one bill. I refuse to stand by and let this long-overdue agenda go down without a fight. That's why I took a moment to write an op-ed for the Washington Post that discusses why we must continue doing everything possible to move forward on Build Back Better. As the Omicron variant continues to upend people's ability to work, care for children and elders, access medical care, and so much more, it's clear: we cannot afford to abandon our vision. Not with so much on the line. Broken promises cannot deter the path to Build Back Better By: Pramila Jayapal December 26, 2021 Nearly a year ago, President Biden laid out his Build Back Better agenda: a broad vision to meet the individual and collective challenges Americans face, necessarily ambitious to address crises both created and exposed by the pandemic. For most of 2021, Democrats worked to pass legislation that realizes that vision. The president negotiated with Congress, including Sens. Joe Manchin III (D-W.Va.) and Kyrsten Sinema (D-Ariz.) directly. Sen. Manchin committed to the president — who relayed that commitment to House members — that he would support the legislative framework unveiled on Oct. 28. But on Dec. 20, Sen. Manchin went back on his commitment to the president and seemingly killed the bill on national television. In a town where your word is everything, this was a stunning rebuke of his own party's president. Despite that, we must move forward. The president's agenda is even more urgent today. The omicron variant is surging as covid-19 has once again disrupted people's ability to work, care for children and elders, access medical care and make ends meet. We simply cannot abandon our vision. To craft a path forward, it's important to look at how we got here. Last spring, the Congressional Progressive Caucus (CPC) called for one comprehensive bill to deliver the president's agenda. But seeking a show of bipartisanship, the White House, at the urging of conservative Democratic senators, split the legislation into two vehicles: what eventually became the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and the Build Back Better Act. The latter contained 85 percent of the president's domestic agenda. This decision's effect was to push Build Back Better — and the communities it would uniquely benefit — to the back of the line. People of color, women and young people helped deliver the White House and Congress to Democrats, but their needs were consistently delayed in search of bipartisanship. Low-hanging bipartisan provisions were prioritized over the transformational: child care to allow women to return to the workplace, assistance for caregiving jobs primarily held by immigrant women of color, climate action, lower drug prices, a road map to citizenship for immigrants, and tax reforms taking on special interests. Dividing the president's agenda gave corporate America a chance to dedicate itself to killing Build Back Better. When Senate Democrats passed the infrastructure bill without a commitment of support for Build Back Better, the CPC was left to protect the latter — often in the face of remarkable pressure. Yet a majority of our caucus twice held the line, refusing to pass infrastructure until serious negotiations took place on Build Back Better. President Biden worked with the two senators and the House to craft the Oct. 28 framework agreement. The CPC held the line again to translate the framework into legislation, inking an agreement with six remaining holdouts among House Democrats to ensure our chamber passed both bills. A majority of our members relied on the president's word that he had a commitment from Sen. Manchin to support the framework. We believed we had reached our point of maximum leverage — and if we held up infrastructure again, Sen. Manchin would walk away from Build Back Better entirely and possibly even both proposals. The Progressive Caucus will continue to work toward legislation for Build Back Better, focused on keeping it as close to the agreed-upon framework as possible. At the same time, we are calling on the president to use executive action to immediately improve people's lives. Taking executive action will also make clear to those who hinder Build Back Better that the White House and Democrats will deliver for Americans. The CPC will soon release a plan for these actions, including lowering costs, protecting the health of every family, and showing the world that the United States is serious about our leadership on climate action. We can't be naive about the difficulty of once again negotiating with someone who has not kept his commitments. But legislation remains the best path for delivering enduring relief. Nor can we underestimate the urgency to act, especially as covid is surging and so many constituencies — seniors, people of color, working and young people — are disillusioned. Democrats must prove that their voices and their votes matter, and that we can produce tangible economic assistance. The Progressive Caucus has always believed in leaving no one behind. body:
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the Un
| _Sponsored message_ |
---|---|---
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2mgr4dbauudid0lg8sdu167g6hrch7mfag9r2h0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3fqqrtmom47t1vt76l0sok0goi3pdf9hjik0t3o_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg7efcr9suuqm8cmjvv93u0lqmn32hs3fcovocc8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmc5kuvdppd23bg0j15f7cldbah8vpc1dd846jg8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z38ebve2heu7puc9325bq85u9omr5qfvd64t6e48_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. And they brought it to news outlets like Fox News, Newsmax, the Blaze, and numerous talk radio shows. Ultimately, Campus Reform’s exposure of the truth got _results_. In these cases and many others, **Campus Reform’s quick and powerful action forced universities to change their anti-conservative policies, discipline leftist student groups, and suspend or fire radical professors.** I believe an angel gets its wings every time a leftist professor is fired for their outrageous and unapologetic abuses against conservatives. But Campus Reform’s fight to make the left see the light and feel the heat won’t be won overnight. **To fight the forces of the intolerant left, stand up for free speech, and protect conservative students who want to simply share their beliefs without getting a black eye, Campus Reform is counting on your help.** [**Please make a generous investment of $25, $35, $50, or more today to support the Leadership Institute’s Campus Reform, stand up to liberal indoctrination, and ensure conservative students don’t lose their freedoms on college campuses.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8n7btsevl0kgrleu8v5aait6f4a4f6hsmhkmhe0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) Friend, let’s make ‘em pay. [**Please help Campus Reform right away so they can empower conservative students and strike back at the lunatic liberals.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9pdale4lovd5rjf06guql2hudmvek1t5eoc5oug_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) Thank you. In liberty, Ann Coulter **P.S. Remember, when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book,_Resistance is Futile_.** It’s just one more way I can thank you for joining this crucial cause. Because **if we lose the kids, we lose this country.** [**Please donate right away.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6es4udgqov5b5duk1m8kadhibndmh014ecln9og_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs) Thank you.** [ **Yes, I'll join Campus Reform in the fight against leftist tyranny** ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zojuriatcj9f1vkoqo669an5nppg8frtc13igufg_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6cob6cph2bs)

Hi, it’s Morgan. **We have 3 days until we reach our FEC fundraising deadline of 2021 at midnight on December 31st.**
This is our last fundraising hurdle before the new year and I’ll be honest — [**we still have a long way to go before we reach our $50,000 email fundraising goal.**](https://act.morganharper.org/go/18689?t=3&akid=480%2E90090%2EjG_NhM)
The response from folks like you has been amazing since we launched our campaign in mid-August. Your small-dollar donations are the reason we’re still in this race and why we had such a strong record-smashing start to our journey.
But I’ll be honest, since then, _our fundraising has seriously slowed down_. We’re finishing our first full fundraising quarter of this campaign, and things aren’t looking good. This has been one of the toughest online fundraising periods in recent memory, for campaigns all across the country, and we really can’t afford to fall short of our **$50,000 email fundraising goal**.
I believe in this team, and every time it’s looked like we weren’t going to meet our goal, this team has pulled through. That’s why I wanted to ring in the new year by giving back to you. 🎊
**[Any contribution you make right now — no matter how big or small — will automatically enter you in our competition to win a special edition “Morganize against the world” sweatshirt.](https://act.morganharper.org/go/18689?t=4&akid=480%2E90090%2EjG_NhM) **
**[Enter to win »](https://act.morganharper.org/go/18471?refcode=em20211228-480&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=480%2E90090%2EjG_NhM)**
Together, we’re showing that we can run a strong, people-powered, grassroots campaign without taking contributions from fossil fuels, super PACs, or corporations. But it’s going to take all of us coming together to fight for a better Ohio.
[**So what do you say****, are you in? Together we can smash our last fundraising goal of the year before December 31, show our legitimacy as a campaign, and ensure that we have the resources to start election year off strong.**](https://act.morganharper.org/go/18689?t=6&akid=480%2E90090%2EjG_NhM)

Thank you for everything you do,
Morgan

**‘But he’s Jewish’: Opponent questions Mandel’s faith in Ohio Senate primary debate**
_By Natalie Allison Politico_
A Republican Senate candidate in Ohio is doubling down on a controversial campaign ad, insisting voters need to be aware of an important fact: that the frontrunner in the primary is Jewish.

Mark Pukita, an IT entrepreneur in the crowded GOP race, during a Thursday night candidate forum defended a campaign ad that questioned the faith of opponent Josh Mandel.

A moderator at the debate, held by the Ohio Press Network at North Columbus Baptist Church, asked for Pukita to respond to claims that he is “antisemitic and intentionally divisive and inflammatory.”

"In terms of antisemitism, all I did in an ad was pointed out that Josh is going around saying he's got the Bible in one hand and the constitution in the other. But he's Jewish,” Pukita said. “Everybody should know that though, right?"

Pukita was referring to a radio ad created by his campaign that criticized Mandel for courting evangelical Christians and frequently visiting churches on the campaign trail.

“Are we seriously supposed to believe the most Christian-values Senate candidate is Jewish?”

# Statement on Lakewood Shooting
---
| (Dec. 28, 2021) The following is a statement by U.S. Congressional candidate Erik Aadland regarding the shooting tragedy in Denver and Lakewood Monday night. Erik recently announced his bid for Congress in Congressional District 7.
"I am saddened and disturbed by yesterday's shooting spree that began in Denver and ended in Lakewood. My heart is heavy for the victims and their families. It is difficult to make sense of this, and I am prayerful at this time for everyone impacted by this tragedy.
"Yet, thoughts and prayers are not enough. Today we mourn, but tomorrow we must act to address rising crime. Tougher penalties and better supported law enforcement are needed to ensure our citizens can feel safe in their communities once again. And families must maintain their right to protect themselves."

body:
College campuses have gone absolutely insane.
