College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbkncbttq2arbe8jvstc74f0dadacrsi526ndlg8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z94kedc9kpl15d6s5a65gq4v41qrf1o1uqucppdo_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zl0rrfr25s1k2iovgqmhea1dmabps3dido50bkao_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zikru6v1v7ov86oonf21gui71uj8nnj3j5gm6bu8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3k5hiig5pe7tsdb40vti8d8eqt1a4p2daoklmm0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. And they brought it to news outlets like Fox News, Newsmax, the Blaze, and numerous talk radio shows. Ultimately, Campus Reform’s exposure of the truth got _results_. In these cases and many others, **Campus Reform’s quick and powerful action forced universities to change their anti-conservative policies, discipline leftist student groups, and suspend or fire radical professors.** I believe an angel gets its wings every time a leftist professor is fired for their outrageous and unapologetic abuses against conservatives. But Campus Reform’s fight to make the left see the light and feel the heat won’t be won overnight. **To fight the forces of the intolerant left, stand up for free speech, and protect conservative students who want to simply share their beliefs without getting a black eye, Campus Reform is counting on your help.** [**Please make a generous investment of $25, $35, $50, or more today to support the Leadership Institute’s Campus Reform, stand up to liberal indoctrination, and ensure conservative students don’t lose their freedoms on college campuses.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z2tj4k97g2a20746v4d41tdgmiu4vrqteajfo0fo_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) Friend, let’s make ‘em pay. [**Please help Campus Reform right away so they can empower conservative students and strike back at the lunatic liberals.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zpc4fapnkm34vvl4ssfej1ubopu37mne7ru7kh6g_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) Thank you. In liberty, Ann Coulter **P.S. Remember, when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book,_Resistance is Futile_.** It’s just one more way I can thank you for joining this crucial cause. Because **if we lose the kids, we lose this country.** [**Please donate right away.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9epmh1abavto0kcleoa014schu3191mg1m690g8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs) Thank you.** [ **Yes, I'll join Campus Reform in the fight against leftist tyranny** ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn2p65id6ohbgf818tbgucf2nct33pio0ingg4vg_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cth6eo36c9h2bs)

body:

#
_As part of Team AOC, we send periodic updates from the Squad Victory Fund. If you unsubscribe, you'll stop receiving all Team AOC emails. **2022 is right around the corner, and AOC, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida will soon be up for re-election**
Last year, Republicans and super PACs spent tens of millions of dollars in a failed attempt to derail our movement for progress — but the people sent the Squad back to Congress with a mandate to keep fighting for the bold change our communities need.
Here’s the thing: Republicans are already ramping up their attacks against AOC, Ilhan, Rashida, and Ayanna in the lead up to the 2022 midterm elections — and we need to be prepared for anything they’ll throw our way. That’s why it’s so important we reach our $800,000 end-of-year goal.
[If you can, will you donate to the Squad Victory Fund right now to help us reach our $800,000 goal before December 31st? Every donation will help keep Ilhan, AOC, Rashida, and Ayanna in Congress, fighting for all of us.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/10356?refcode=em20211228-2704-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=2704%2E2526796%2EL_zbdg)

Our Squad is BIG, and with your support, we’ll have the resources we need to go up against the Republicans and special interests working to maintain the unjust status quo and keep growing our progressive movement.
[Donate today to help us keep Ayanna, Alexandria, Ilhan, and Rashida in Congress and expand our movement for justice and equity. The Squad Victory Fund is 100% people-powered, so every donation makes a big impact.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/10356?refcode=em20211228-2704-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=2704%2E2526796%2EL_zbdg)

In a moment, I'm going to ask you to support our people-powered campaign to keep Georgia blue and help Democrats hold the Senate. **But first, I want to explain why your support is so important -- and what could happen without it.**

My Senate seat is one of Republicans’ biggest targets, and my opponent already has the full support of Donald Trump, Mitch McConnell, and their dark-money allies. And with CNN ranking mine as the most likely Democratic seat to flip, we’re depending on this grassroots team more than ever. Friend, next year’s election will be an uphill battle, but throughout my life, nothing has come without a struggle. I grew up in public housing in Savannah, Georgia, but through hard work and determination I was the first in my family to graduate college. subject: College campuses have gone insane
body:
A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6615%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=vgukFpYS4obFknp%2fLo64DQ&sysid=1)
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68254%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6uIGGf%2fCRZKqQA8yW9BS2A&sysid=1) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68265%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FYZRZDRQBYS9cx5rSMnI7A&sysid=1) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech - and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched - because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68266%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lgMXkDkMUAuYBYH361MOnA&sysid=1) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line - Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you - yes, you! - which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68267%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9DyLOehBCIomDk6xsQbZXQ&sysid=1) And to sweeten the pot - when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68268%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mEcAQZAD3547b%2b8cnT%2b0Og&sysid=1) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. And they brought it to news outlets like Fox News, Newsmax, the Blaze, and numerous talk radio shows. Ultimately, Campus Reform’s exposure of the truth got _results_. In these cases and many others, **Campus Reform’s quick and powerful action forced universities to change their anti-conservative policies, discipline leftist student groups, and suspend or fire radical professors.** I believe an angel gets its wings every time a leftist professor is fired for their outrageous and unapologetic abuses against conservatives. But Campus Reform’s fight to make the left see the light and feel the heat won’t be won overnight. **To fight the forces of the intolerant left, stand up for free speech, and protect conservative students who want to simply share their beliefs without getting a black eye, Campus Reform is counting on your help.** [**Please make a generous investment of $25, $35, $50, or more today to support the Leadership Institute’s Campus Reform, stand up to liberal indoctrination, and ensure conservative students don’t lose their freedoms on college campuses.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68269%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8N9R7%2f8W8Z2LEpRBq4PJ%2bg&sysid=1) Friend, let’s make ‘em pay. [**Please help Campus Reform right away so they can empower conservative students and strike back at the lunatic liberals.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68260%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7TCUFXxnwhIdK8N6bp4kHQ&sysid=1) Thank you. In liberty, Ann Coulter **P.S. Remember, when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book,_Resistance is Futile_.** It’s just one more way I can thank you for joining this crucial cause. Because **if we lose the kids, we lose this country.** [**Please donate right away.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68261%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CxLF0HaZdq32Q83bWqgGKw&sysid=1)**Thank you.** [ **Yes, I'll join Campus Reform in the fight against leftist tyranny** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68262%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4S%2bm%2bEDO0%2bUJKd61zosnXw&sysid=1)

|
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)

---
Peter,

You and I have fought together for freedom for years now. T**he increasingly radical Democrats will stop at nothing to force their socialist agenda on America,** which is why they are directing all their resources towards breaking the 50-50 Senate tie and increasing their power in Washington.

_Their top target?_ Missouri's soon-to-be vacated U.S. Senate seat currently held by a Republican. America, and Missouri, literally cannot afford for the Democrats to come in and take this seat. **We must band together and support a rock-solid conservative who is prepared for the job - Missouri 's own, Congressman Billy Long.**

[**I 've already joined Billy on the campaign trail, and plan to continue, but need grassroots conservatives like you to join us.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)
Your support is vital to not only Billy Long, but the Republican Party in what's set to be one of the _TOUGHEST_ Senate races in the country. [**Will you join me by chipping in $10 or more right now to Billy Long for Senate?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)

[** SUPPORT BILLY LONG NOW ➞ **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)
From day one in Washington, **Billy fought to implement the America First Agenda by standing up to Communist China and encouraging American companies to expand right here in the United States.** He has cut taxes and regulations, and helped small businesses thrive. Billy is a friend to the unborn, our military veterans and law enforcement. **His loyalty to the American people has never wavered.**

_I 'm writing to tell you this:_ **If we put Billy Long in the U.S. Senate, we won 't have to worry about him giving into the swamp.** His vote will be for you. What you see is what you get. He's been in Washington for 10 years, **but he 's never been of Washington.**

He's not just talking the talk, like the power-hungry Democrats do. Billy passed legislation to release Missourian workers from unnecessary government regulations, improving their economic situation and quality of life.

_Sounds like the opposite of what the radical-Democrats are doing in Washington, right?_ **Because unlike Joe Biden, Kamala Harris or Chuck Schumer, Billy understands that Americans should ALWAYS come first.** That's the type of Republican we need fighting for us, Peter.

This race is going to be competitive and it will certainly be one of the most expensive battles we see this cycle. [**The only way we 're going to be able to keep Missouri in Republican hands is if conservatives like you join our team right now.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)

[** SUPPORT BILLY LONG NOW ➞ **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)
Even President Trump is confident that we can and will take back the Senate, but that plan becomes increasingly difficult if the Democrats swoop in and buy and lie their way into one of our red-state seats. **Let me tell you, Democrats already have their eyes and pocketbooks set on Missouri.**

They aren't wasting any time using big corporations and dark-money donors to pad their campaign accounts. [**Peter, that 's why I am counting on you to step up immediately, asking that you give generously to ensure my friend Billy Long has the resources he needs to keep Missouri RED for the Republican Party.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)

Thank you,

Kellyanne Conway
Former Counselor to President Donald J. Trump

[** SUPPORT BILLY LONG NOW ➞ **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59121812:JxvayCENG:m:1:3253819041:1B625DB9716586E6DE9EAAF8E9C30E29:r)

body: Dear Peter, Joe Biden won last year's election by more than four percent and seven million votes - but because of the way the Electoral College currently works, a swing of just 25,000 or so votes in handful of states would have handed the election to Donald Trump. State legislatures are about to begin a new session - and we need them to prioritize fixing our democracy. [ https://act.demandprogress.org/go/33657?t=1001&akid=28753%2E8104458%2Eo3MtCW ]Click here to tell your state legislators to support the National Popular Vote bill to make sure the person with the most votes is elected president. In a democracy, it should be common sense that the candidate who wins the most votes becomes the president. Yet, two of the past four presidents were elected to the nation’s highest office after losing the popular vote. There’s no sugarcoating it: This is a blatantly anti-democratic system of choosing the president. That's because the way the United States elects presidents, through the electoral college, wasn't designed to be democratic. But states themselves are complicit in this anti-democratic system: They choose how to allocate their own electoral college votes, regardless of who won the popular vote across America. You can change that, by telling your state legislators to ensure that states agree to allocate their electoral college votes to the presidential candidate who wins the national popular vote. [ https://act.demandprogress.org/go/33657?t=1002&akid=28753%2E8104458%2Eo3MtCW ]Tell your legislators: Support the National Popular Vote bill! The way the states allocate their electoral college votes right now isn’t just anti-democratic. It also means that presidential candidates only have to focus their energy on winning voter support in the few swing states where electoral college votes are up for grabs. When Trump won the presidency, despite losing the popular vote, he carried Michigan by a bare 11,000 votes, Wisconsin by 23,000, and Pennsylvania by 44,000. In other words, 78,000 votes in three states cancelled out the nearly 3 million votes that Trump lost by in the popular vote. This very nearly happened again last month - in an even more extreme way. If just 25,000 or so votes had been switched in Arizona, Georgia, and Wisconsin then Trump would have won the electoral college. [ https://act.demandprogress.org/go/33657?t=1003&akid=28753%2E8104458%2Eo3MtCW ]Tell your legislators: Support the National Popular Vote bill! Two-thirds of states had barely any presidential campaign events during the 2020 general election cycle, because winning votes in non-battleground states isn’t a rational strategy under this system. There's also another, more serious consequence of this messy system: we run the risk of having another situation like the 2000 election, where the U.S. Supreme Court decided to stop counting ballots in Florida and hand the election to George W. Bush. The U.S. Supreme Court should never be asked to decide a presidential election again. So how can we restore our democracy? Fifteen states and Washington D.C. have already signed onto the National Popular Vote compact to agree to allocate their electoral college votes to the presidential candidate who wins the popular vote. We just need a few more states to sign on, so that a majority of the electoral college votes are committed to the president who wins the popular vote. Can you tell your representative to support the compact, and ensure that in all future presidential elections, every vote in every state matters? State legislatures are about to meet - and we need them to prioritize fixing our democracy. [ https://act.demandprogress.org/go/33657?t=1004&akid=28753%2E8104458%2Eo3MtCW ]Tell your legislators: Support the National Popular Vote bill! # Looking forward towards 2022.
As we celebrate with our loved ones and look forward to 2022, we wanted to take a moment to thank you for being part of this movement. We helped deliver food and gifts to people for the holidays. We supported a coalition of southside organizers in delivering 62,000 bottles of water to our friends and family in Statesville.

And most importantly, we have been reaching out and talking to our neighbors in the 1st District. The concerns people have are familiar: healthcare, education, housing, community stability. And over and over again, people are telling us that they are ready for a change.

We have a lot of exciting things planned for 2022. [To kick things off, we will be launching our petition drive on January 15th! ](https://drameena.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e8541e883c7e489c2cd5d45b&id=1bd795981c&e=5fba611a2c)So please save the date, and come down to help us get Dr. Ameena on the ballot. We also need your help paying for all of the supplies we will need. [Please consider making a year-end donation to the campaign!](https://drameena.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e8541e883c7e489c2cd5d45b&id=230a847337&e=5fba611a2c)

In Solidarity,

Jessica

| | | [](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zv4e37p7iuhp73du30430nkok0gc0rmpi6oe41g8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj60or4cph2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2ztja56bc3upep52td47khhmlcrhn34qmnicopp2o_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj60or4cph2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zeteatun8gfadk909ojh09h8bjh2obl96246e1e0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj60or4cph2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zc2cqbogd224ji67kaod429bbn1g1a64t8rjmefo_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj60or4cph2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zhsu99hfcr1948ua5s39grbf8rcqtvhfup4potio_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj60or4cph2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. were able to raise at the end of this year.

and voters — will be looking to see how we did.

resources to win. If enough people pitch in, we can defy the conventional

raise and excite the folks who might still be sitting on the sidelines.

Friend,
Our re-election campaign has a $25,000 fundraising goal that we must reach before our end-of-year deadline expires on Friday.

name: Mike Pompeo
subject: America is not a racist nation.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHAMPION AMERICAN VALUES
body:
I’m personally asking you to renew our commitment to putting America and our values first
& nbsp; &nb; sp;
Not interested? [Unsubscribe Here](https://trk.cp20.com/form?363ho--fgxr-4qqlpo0&sl=2d&t=5&ac=gh7s)

|
| | | | [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-363ho-1r0f2-4qqlpo9/)
---

I’m going to say something that no politician ever will: The answer to our nation’s problems isn’t politics. It’s affecting change in the hearts of people. That takes leaders of principle who won’t put their finger in the wind of politics to make decisions, but will adhere to principle, even when it’s not popular.

As Secretary of State in the Trump Administration, I was determined to demonstrate how my faith and our Judeo-Christian founding could improve our world. Shining our light and evangelizing are biblical requirements, not challenges to the so-called separation of church and state.

Leaders are in people-intensive lines of work. They appeal to hearts and minds to change behavior. And as believers, we draw on the wisdom of God to help us get it right...to be a force for good in the lives of human beings.

I know some people in the media will break out the pitchforks when they hear that I ask God for direction in my work. But that isn’t a new idea. I really relied on God when I was a fifth-grade Sunday school teacher, and my job was to keep the boys in their seats. It was the best preparation for international diplomacy you can imagine!

I say all this because our nation is truly at a crossroads. It is up to people like you and me to lead in championing American values. If we’re going to win this battle, we need you to step up, stay in the fight and defend the America we love. If we don’t, we’re going to lose it.

So, I’m personally asking you to renew your commitment to putting America and our values first—because when we put America and Americans first, we prosper and the whole world prospers. **When America leads from the front and not from behind, we are a better nation.**

I believe America has a bright future. Why?

Because of the promise in Jeremiah that God has a plan for us; a plan that will prosper and not harm us. A plan for hope and a future if we will follow Him.

**That is why I believe in America—I believe we are a good and great nation.**

Not a defeated nation.
Not a racist nation.
We are a God Blessed nation—and I want to keep it that way.

If you share these concerns, then I'm inviting you to join my Conservative Cavalry of patriots who love America and are committed to championing the core values that make our country great.

---
| | [JOIN THE CONSERVATIVE CAVALRY](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-363ho-1r0f3-4qqlpo0/)
---

I won’t let the woke socialists replace our American values with the religion of Marxism! Don’t complain about what’s happening—let’s fight and defeat the other side and defend our American values. Please, **[join my Conservative Cavalry today so we can work together to save America!](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-363ho-1r0f4-4qqlpo1/ "join my Conservative Cavalry today so we can work together to save America!")**

Fighting for our Future,
---
| [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-363ho-1r0f5-4qqlpo2/)
---
Mike Pompeo
70th Secretary of State

I need your help if we are going to **WIN BIG** for Republicans in the upcoming elections.

I've spent my life fighting for our American values, and I'm keeping that fight alive by supporting principled conservative candidates all across the country. **[Will you chip in to help us stop the radical Left from turning America into a socialist country?](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-363ho-1r0f7-4qqlpo4/ "Will you chip in to help us stop the radical Left from turning America into a socialist country?")**

Thanks again for all that you do, and let's keep up the good work!

** Newsletter-December Vol. 1, #5
------------------------------------------------------------

** 28 December 21
------------------------------------------------------------

** Only 4 Days Remaining!
------------------------------------------------------------
As you might recall, the campaign launched a fundraising initiative in early November. At that time, we were just beginning. Our goal has been to reach $35,000 by December 31. Why December 31 and why $35,000? December 31 marks the end of the fourth quarter. January would be campaign's first mandatory reporting with the Federal Elections Commission. We wanted to have a strong first reporting to demonstrate the seriousness of our campaign.
Over the last 35 years in District 4, the top fundraisers were at approximately, $76,000, $35,000 and $14,000. By crossing the $35,000 mark, we could report that we were the second highest fundraising campaign in the last 35 years.

We are grateful, humbled and excited to report that over $12,000 has been donated in about 6 weeks! That's quite remarkable, especially during the frantic and hectic holiday season.

Please join us in giving and praying for these last few days of 2021 to help us reach the $35,000 level by December 31. Donations postmarked by December 31 count towards this fourth quarter goal.

Donate Here (https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=ea0eb0d83e&e=12a37459a2) and Thank You For Your Amazing Support!

Jeff Is Fighting For You!

Twelve Marylanders, including Jeff, are named plaintiffs in Judicial Watch’s Lawsuit to end the egregious gerrymandering in Maryland. Jeff shared, “Voters should pick their representatives; Representatives should not pick their voters. All Marylanders deserve to be represented. Gerrymandering is simply a raw and blatant abuse of power.”

View The Judicial Watch Press Release Here (https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=0faec82ff3&e=12a37459a2)

Meet & Greets

The campaign has been hosting virtual and in-person Meet & Greets with Jeff. Who do you know that shares our concern for the Country? Consider inviting them to meet Jeff and learn how they can make difference.

Remember, Jeff is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. There is hope.

Please share this newsletter with others.

Standing with you,

Jeff

From: Chris Van Hollen Date: Tue, Dec 28, 2021 Subject: I share your alarm By a strong margin, protecting voting rights was the issue of most concern to those who completed the survey — and I share your alarm. The recent laws being passed by Republican state legislatures around the country make access to the ballot box more difficult, particularly for people of color and younger voters. And they give political operatives in some states the power to overturn election results! These laws threaten the legitimacy of our electoral process. And as we approach a midterm election that could shape our country for generations, the potenital implications are enormous. We simply cannot afford to fail to act. As I have been, I will continue to work to push the Senate to end or amend the filibuster in order to protect voting rights when the Senate returns on January 3rd. With Republicans — and Trump — eyeing 2022 as their springboard for the 2024 presidential election, everything is on the line in these upcoming midterm elections. [That’s why I’m reaching back out to ask for your input, friends. # [Sign the petition: Tell Congress to pass the Build Back Better Act – don’t let the Child Tax Credit expire!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcc3dc74b-a72f-4906-a596-03fa6b6568e5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Millions of children across the country have been lifted out of poverty thanks to the expanded Child Tax Credit, which was passed in July as part of the American Rescue Plan. For months, families received much needed funds to cover expenses and put food on the table. Now, the expanded child tax credit is set to expire at the end of the year, with no extension in sight – leaving families no time to prepare. But we still have a chance to give families the support they need! President Biden’s Build Back Better Act will extend the child tax credit for years – we just need to demand the Senate pass it. We can’t allow millions of children to fall back into poverty. clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | Millions of children across the country have been lifted out of poverty thanks to the expanded Child Tax Credit, which was passed in July as part of the American Rescue Plan. For months, families received much needed funds to cover expenses and put food on the table. Now, the expanded child tax credit is set to expire at the end of the year, with no extension in sight – leaving families no time to prepare. But we still have a chance to give families the support they need! President Biden’s Build Back Better Act will extend the child tax credit for years – we just need to demand the Senate pass it. Hey, folks, I hope you’re enjoying the winter holidays. Michael and I have been spending time with the girls reflecting on the year as a whole. Michael’s dedication to our state is clear: opportunities for the next generation, our beautiful public lands, and Colorado’s future guide every meeting he joins, phone call he makes, and every negotiation he leads. Michael is focused on delivering for Colorado. This year:
* He led the charge to expand the Child Tax Credit, which has helped one million Colorado kids and kept nearly 4 million kids out of poverty nationwide.

* Michael fought to roll back Trump’s policies that hurt our state’s environment and left Tribal communities out of critical conversations regarding the public lands they hold sacred.

* He secured a historic investment to expand high-speed internet access to bridge the digital divide for poor, rural, and Tribal communities while helping Coloradans compete in our global 21st-century economy.

All this and more makes Michael a top target for the National GOP, but he’s so focused on building on this progress that there isn’t much time to fundraise. name: Gov. Laura Kelly
subject: one last update from Kansas
body:
Derek,

National Republicans will stop at nothing to flip Kansas' governor's seat in 2022. Political analysts from Inside Elections, Cook Political Report, The Kansas City Star, and Nate Silver's FiveThirtyEight are all calling me one of the most vulnerable Democratic governors up for re-election in 2022 -- and now The National Journal is weighing in.

I'm the only Democratic governor running for re-election in 2022 in a state that President Biden lost -- and in a new article, The National Journal highlighted how national Republicans plan on helping my extreme opponent win in 2022.

I need to be blunt with you: all of the progress we've made so far -- a fully funded public education system, an economy on the mend, and expanded broadband -- will be under attack if we lose to our extreme Republican opponent in 2022.

We're closing in on our last deadline of 2021, and right now, we only need 175 more donors to pitch in to help us hit our goal. Can you split a donation between my campaign and CommonGood before December ends?
[
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_kelly?refcode=20211228_CGVA_Kelly]

Falling behind is not an option. There's simply too much at stake -- especially with our extreme right-wing opponent and his special interest allies fully focused on doing whatever it takes to flip the governor's office in 2022.

I need to know I can count on your support to help us hit this goal. Pitch in $5, or whatever you can, right now to help us hit our 1,000 grassroots donor mid-month goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_kelly?refcode=20211228_CGVA_Kelly]

Thank you,

Laura Kelly

They had to budget their money and pick presents. We went in and out of stores, looking, comparing prices, searching for the perfect gifts. Wrapped, these presents went under the Christmas tree for opening Christmas Eve. It was so fun watching the gift opening. In many ways, they were more excited to see their gifts opened than to receive their own.

Thomas continues to give all he has and all he can muster for his campaign, as he did at Christmas growing up. It’s his nature. And he rejoices at your generosity to him and his campaign. | | Dear ,
[We have just under ONE WEEK left! ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=e6c739d041&e=44b8c466b0)

**My name is Mark Finchem, and I am the Election Integrity, America-First Patriot running for Secretary of State in Arizona.**

_I have been endorsed by President Trump and have done as much as anyone in the country in pursuing freer and safer elections for all._

We are pushing for three key things the end of this year.
* First, Audit Pima County – we began this task by holding a critical election integrity hearing.
* Two, Pressure Mark Brnovich – we must demand perp walks for those responsible.
* Three, Secure victory for Republicans in 2022.

These tasks are simple, but they are not easy, especially with the mainstream media acting like Election Integrity is some fringe movement, when it is the very same movement that launched the United States – freedom from tyranny and freedom from oppressors.

**Isn’t that exactly what this movement is?**
---
| [ ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=34488d2480&e=44b8c466b0)
---
| _And this is why I just introduced new legislation to this effect._

**I just introduced legislation to launch the Ballot Fraud Countermeasures Program. This puts a watermark on the ballot that is counterfeit-proof.**

**_This provides a paper-trail and also makes ballots as secure as US currency – the way they should be!_**

Check out an example of this ballot here below:
---
| [ ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=88c3632424&e=44b8c466b0)
---
| There will also be QR codes which allow voters to set a PIN and actually see their ballot and what happens to it.

**Folks, this has never been done before. This is what I am pushing for every day and will continue to push for as Secretary of State of Arizona!**

And this is going nationwide.

We already have 7 states we are working with that have demonstrated an interested in protecting their ballots with this technology.

**This bill will also go back to paper ballots and hand counting as the primary means of counting. Let’s go back to what we KNOW works.**
**_This brings people BACK into the system, instead of separating elections from the people._**
These are all things that I am working on now, and I will fully bring to fruition as Arizona’s Secretary of State. But I CANNOT do it without your help.

[**We have to raise $50,000 by the end of the month and we are only $25,849 away. Please help my campaign with a generous donation today!**](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=78b7ee8d45&e=44b8c466b0)

[_Every dollar you donate helps us push for Election Integrity and push for more extensive, nationwide, ballot-protection measures._

_Please help with a generous contribution to Election Integrity!_](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=ee8c6aa0cf&e=44b8c466b0)

Conservative

name: Ann Coulter
subject: Liberals have lost their minds – butthere’s hope
body:
College campuses have gone absolutely insane.
_Sponsored message_
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqom9u8488a8kbth31ip6hq4dsu5s77t8bkelf8g_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0sef2gj21e58ifl6182ni0p738kaah5v1397nro_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp3f3iscc5kr27601obd1oa57npiaoiuuv6ekhs8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkiasop7n0mirqb2hf24lrnmjg2jd6pa6h7njp88_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z09sei4a49i77n9d5tllcsg007m23dal5dvqrn28_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. And they brought it to news outlets like Fox News, Newsmax, the Blaze, and numerous talk radio shows. Ultimately, Campus Reform’s exposure of the truth got _results_. In these cases and many others, **Campus Reform’s quick and powerful action forced universities to change their anti-conservative policies, discipline leftist student groups, and suspend or fire radical professors.** I believe an angel gets its wings every time a leftist professor is fired for their outrageous and unapologetic abuses against conservatives. But Campus Reform’s fight to make the left see the light and feel the heat won’t be won overnight. **To fight the forces of the intolerant left, stand up for free speech, and protect conservative students who want to simply share their beliefs without getting a black eye, Campus Reform is counting on your help.** [**Please make a generous investment of $25, $35, $50, or more today to support the Leadership Institute’s Campus Reform, stand up to liberal indoctrination, and ensure conservative students don’t lose their freedoms on college campuses.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z54r4n0simk1gjdckblknj0i0n56bilpe98n7940_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) Friend, let’s make ‘em pay. [**Please help Campus Reform right away so they can empower conservative students and strike back at the lunatic liberals.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6ktqhbdu63e3osa30m6maufs3t1nfl04mlnmdl0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) Thank you. In liberty, Ann Coulter **P.S. Remember, when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book,_Resistance is Futile_.** It’s just one more way I can thank you for joining this crucial cause. Because **if we lose the kids, we lose this country.** [**Please donate right away.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpppp3bb8ejprlnav6eoc6k3fmj94hj1u914umuo_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs) Thank you.** [ **Yes, I'll join Campus Reform in the fight against leftist tyranny** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zquq7doh80c3unnse1fa3vf8fufqu38hch83r8mg_rp22sh2s8i66ob0ctj66o36c1h2bs)

I'm reaching out for the last time this year on behalf of the DCCC because we're at an absolutely critical moment for our democracy.

Every day, I watch as Donald Trump's Republicans attack our right to vote, undermine trust in our democracy, and spread dangerous lies and conspiracy theories.

Worst of all, they think we're powerless to stop them.

But here's the deal - we can stop them. And we must. Democrats everywhere are standing up and standing strong. Just like me, and just like you.

There is one major cause for concern though. **Republicans have amassed a massive war chest to buy their way back into the Majority, and it will be hard to stop them if we don 't turn the tide soon.**

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi Peter — it’s
Bianca, I’m the campaign manager for Team Booker and wanted to personally
give you an update on the campaign.

We’re about to reach a pivotal moment for our movement:

* As of today, we are just three days away from the end-of-year deadline
before we submit our numbers to the FEC and we’re racing to raise
5,000 grassroots donations.
* It’s critical that we start off 2022 with the resources we need to
power our voter outreach and organizing efforts up until Election Day.
Reaching out to Kentuckians from the hood to the holler is key to us
winning next year.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14267?refcode=em20211228-1377&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=1377%2E346206%2ELUGral ]We’re hoping you and 1 other supporter from 18326 can chip
in $5 today to help us reach our goal. Every dollar counts
especially now that we’re approaching election year — we rely 100% on
grassroots supporters like you to power this work.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14267?refcode=em20211228-1377&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1377%2E346206%2ELUGral ]Contribute $5

Let me explain why this goal is critical:

For too long, Rand Paul has consistently ignored Kentuckians — he doesn’t
care that hospitals are at max capacity from the rise in COVID cases, how
long someone has been out of a job, or whether families can afford rent
next week. He’s a politician who will say or do anything to get in the
news, put the spotlight on himself and his conspiracy theories, and sell
us out to big industries.

But now, we have a historic chance to turn the tides of our future.
Thousands of Kentuckians from the hood to the holler are rising up with us
to elect Charles Booker and send a working class champion to the U.S.
Senate. Our campaign is gaining momentum, but we need your continued
support to make it to the finish line.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14267?refcode=em20211228-1377&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1377%2E346206%2ELUGral ]Peter, if
you can afford to give just $5, it’ll go a long way in helping us reach
our goal so we can out-organize Rand Paul. We’re hoping you can show your
support from 18326 and show the strength of our movement.

Let’s do this,

Bianca

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

My team and I just had a meeting to discuss what funds we have available to respond to the nasty attack ads that have been running against me over the holidays. Multiple friends told me they've spotted the ads! This isn't the GOP's first attack, either. They've put up negative billboards in my district too. Unfortunately, we are already behind on fundraising for the month, and I had to decide if we had enough resources to fight back against these latest attacks with additional ads of our own. I've come up against this kind of choice a couple of times now, and I always think that it's better to go bigger than wish we had done more. So, I told my team to add an additional $5,000 to our advertising budget, but I also don't want this to detract from our next fundraising report. That's why I'm coming to you, Peter. Will you step up and make a rapid response donation before our critical end-of-year FEC deadline so we can fight back now and not have to wait until the New Year in order to start reaching voters? | | Dear Friends,

**Oregonians want something to vote for -- not against.** This is the common theme I've picked up after months of traveling to every corner of the state and listening to folks of all walks. They want a Republican nominee who puts forward **common-sense policies** without hiding behind the rhetoric. Most importantly, they want someone who can **defeat the Democratic machine** and break their stranglehold on the governor's office.

**We need a governor who not only has the policy experience, but the life experience, to be a leader for all of Oregon. **I couldn't read or write by the age of 9 and had my first full year of school in the 11th grade. I struggled with homelessness as a teen. And by the age of 26, I opened a state-of-the-art microchip manufacturing company in Southern Oregon that withstood the 2008 Great Recession and has provided good-paying jobs since.

But in order to end one-party rule in Salem, I'll need your help. Time is running out to take advantage of your political tax credit, which allows you to donate $50 (or $100 as a couple) to my campaign and write it all off your taxes.** It's like a free donation! **_Will you consider donating $50 or $100 to help advance my positive vision for Oregon and bring balance back to our state?_

They thought this pettiness would make me stop fighting. Of course, it had precisely the opposite effect. The same will be true this time. It's why they’ve used COVID to make kids as miserable as possible. The fact that they'd take away my position now is telling. It shows our movement is threatening the entire corrupt system. It’s getting bigger by the day. Our opportunities in this coming election are boundless. Wherever my name is on the ballot, I'll be fighting at our Capitol all next year. But I’m also ready to take our fight to the next level and expose this corruption for all to see. | To My Fellow Georgians,
Governor Kemp has proven he won't stand up for medical freedom. I am Vernon Jones, and I am running for Governor to Take Georgia Back. I'm pro-medical freedom and I'll always fight for them.
To Georgians whose jobs are at risk because you are standing up for your rights; I will not abandon you. I encourage you to let your voices be heard & participate in this Medical Freedom Petition. I want Governor Kemp to hear what Georgians tell me everyday. Join me in calling on the Governor to make medical freedom a part of his 2022 legislative agenda. We would like for him to do what Governor DeSantis of Florida did, ban companies from terminating unvaccinated employees.

name: Official Beto Campaign
subject: You’ve been assigned to Anderson County: 28,856 voters
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
New announcement: we’re launching a 254 County Mobilization Plan.
#
We wanted to make sure you saw this exciting announcement.
The secret to winning in a state as big and diverse as Texas is to not to write anyone off. No county is too small, too Republican, or too _anything_ for us to compete for their votes. We need to go _everywhere_ and talk to _everyone_.
**In that spirit, we’re excited to announce our 254 County Mobilization Plan.**
To reach every single voter, we need a budget for organizing and advertising in each corner of Texas. And four days from now, we have a state-mandated fundraising deadline. We’ll publicly report how much we’ve raised. We want to be able to say we’ve reached our fundraising goals to launch a full-fledged campaign in each of Texas’ 254 counties. That’s where you come in!
**We’ve assigned you to sponsor Anderson County in Texas.** More than 28,856 voters are registered there, and we’ve set a goal of raising $14,428 to launch our 254 County Mobilization plan. **Can Beto count on your help to reach Anderson County voters?** **⇢**[**Make a $25 donation to reach 50 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211228-168975&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=4&akid=168975%2E444211%2EopxBz9)**⇢**[**Make a $50 donation to reach 100 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211228-168975&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=5&akid=168975%2E444211%2EopxBz9)**⇢**[**Make a $100 donation to reach 200 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211228-168975&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=6&akid=168975%2E444211%2EopxBz9)**⇢**[**Make a $250 donation to reach 500 voters in Anderson County.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211228-168975&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=7&akid=168975%2E444211%2EopxBz9) **[Sponsor Anderson County»](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211228-168975&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=8&akid=168975%2E444211%2EopxBz9)**
---
It’s true that most Texans live in big cities and counties. But you cannot expect to win in a state like Texas if you write off the rural counties, which are so vital to the future of this state.
Because these places have voted reliably Republican over the last two decades, you’ve seen many state and national Democrats write them off. And because those Democrats stopped showing up, Republicans didn’t have to either. There was no competition for votes.
**Our 254 County Mobilization plan gives us a BIG edge.** You would be surprised at how many people will vote with us if given a chance to hear from our campaign. In counties where most people vote Republican, competing for votes will help us close the margins. And in counties that often vote Democrat, showing up and organizing will help us increase our margins.
**But the plan only works if we can raise enough money to organize, advertise and show up in all 254 counties.**[**Can you help us hit our fundraising goal for Anderson County before the 12/31 Texas Ethics Commission deadline?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/51062?refcode=ema20211228-168975&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=28%2C856&t=9&akid=168975%2E444211%2EopxBz9)
Thank you, for considering a donation to reach the 28,856 registered voters of Anderson County. That’s what a true grassroots campaign looks like. Talking to everyone, writing no one off. Competing for every vote.
\- Team Beto

I just wanted to reach out again in hopes that you had a happy, healthy, and very Merry Christmas.

I know these past few Christmases have been much more different than what we’re used to, but I know the path forward gets more clear every day, even if some in our government want to keep the pandemic a constant crisis.

Regardless of that, I hope you’re day was full of joy and blessings, because if anyone deserves it, Peter, you certainly do.

Thank you and God bless,

**James Tarantin**
Candidate for U.S. Senate

It’s Christmas this weekend Peter,

**To many of us, Christmas is about the divine miracle that shows God is above all in this world.** It’s about celebrating the real reason for this holiday season along with the very Judeo-Christian values that founded these United States.

These values are the reason I got involved in politics. Christmas represents all of those values and shows us why we need to stand up for our beliefs. **I’m the only Israeli-American to run for the United States Senate, and I’m running because even though we see Christmas as a miracle for everyone, many others see America as a miracle in this world.**

I believe that we cannot allow our miracle to be extinguished because of radical liberals like Ilhan Omar and Nancy Pelosi who only want to see us grow weaker by the day. [**We have to stand up for the values that made this nation great to begin with, and I need your help, Peter, to make that happen.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9e91f305532e40c5b622d74175066fbb&_e=3mLQtjdEgHpo3kwjPPFifxbWz4RHnp_kMaGB9B8_4t966VQgC_mfInGWBAYvDhFMaVfPIqFKH2uq2-MGLWUhD47zrdoJXBEKNKyfrFzp_DCtAD2qzJyeWQSHGt_xHW18JO4IpJEDLlPknzBgbT5ND2okqM2hTR_dVamDR9yLdlITCQ-ewVyGmTluGG3YFHwjAMUaMkKaY5k7yw4Qy55fdipMlzRJQZgyVofMJJ8MunbMroMV9vaoOmm8EtmthToz_4O1U6Z3UChY7FltuAuwylqxf9a-SMpoJhixNqPDlL8Jc4S0_63ySD3MsAgemZrvkxFkypL9PGLYdQtTv0fsF3lOsmQaVxCtEAUv5wy7wsUnMRZdj9zJBXjhr7UmSmK5I1D97hDq-Tk6ZQbSZfv2Xqqu65fruQkx30vuAwPeL47A7CzackaS1mRz78yC9bvpiDh-lVUxtNla5XHZM_0yLbx1fFMuc9MRCIbg-LMIxbk422Jxu5lgP3N-QvGjXQpOkQOPu4arJwjdMpp_oHtLUg%3D%3D)

**Just look at the Biden administration. If they actually cared about the values that Christmas shows us, they wouldn’t be trying to befriend terrorist groups or governments that openly persecute Christians, Jews, women, and anyone else they decide is beneath them.**

The people who want to see America fail, or who chant “death to America,” are the same people that these radical liberals want to befriend. These are the people that want to extinguish our values, and I don’t think you could ever support that, because neither could I.

**If you’re anything like me then I know you’re Pro-America and you agree that our nation was founded on Judeo-Christian Values.** We need to get our country back to that way of thinking, and we can get there by winning back the Senate majority.

[**Help me be the reason we win back the U.S. Senate by supporting my campaign to become the next Republican Senator from Maryland. subject: Should we decouple from China?

| Fellow patriot,

_I will work with anyone who's willing to reduce our reliance on China for critical technologies or life sustaining source material_.

Those were my words when I went on Fox News recently to discuss our trade relationship with China.

Simply put, we’ve got to bring manufacturing back home. We can no longer rely on manufacturing in a country run by genocidal communists like the Chinese Communist Party.

We must do everything we can to stand up to China now order to end our reliance on the Chinese Communist Party.

Tracey Mann
